messages:
maya: Morning — quick standup:
- Did: finished smoke onboarding for tiny-quant model (tinyQ-v3) and pushed eval harness updates.
- Blockers: failing rerank tests on long-context prompts, 2x higher false-positive for safety filter on a prompt subset.
- Today: triage rerank regression, update prompt-set A v2, follow up on CR #342 for kv-cache edge case.

hiro: Noted. can you paste the failing eval command? I want to re-run locally.

maya: Sure — ran: `python eval/run_eval.py --model tinyQ-v3 --prompt-set prompts/A_v1.json --metrics rerank,precision,recall`

maya: Error trace snippet:```
AssertionError: score mismatch at idx 412
  expected 0.92 got 0.68
  stack: rerank/score.py:87
```

sam: I'll take a look at CR #342 this morning — saw a kv invalidation edge when sequence length > 4096 after quantization. Could explain degraded rerank for long contexts. @maya can you share a sample prompt where it breaks?

maya: Pasted a short sample in the thread DM to @sam. It's a long system+user chain with code blocks and citations.

eva: Quick heads-up — I bumped a collection of prompt-set A examples through the regression harness; there are 18 examples where safety-filter flips from pass->fail. Might be related to tokenization changes in tinyQ-v3. I can open a small diff PR to revert tokenization tweak for A_v2 if we want to test.

sam: If tokenization changed, rerank scores might shift. Let's not revert yet — instead run an ablation: run eval with old tokenization and new quantization, then with new tokenization and old quantization. We should isolate which change correlates with the FP rate.

hiro: I can provision a small dedicated job on staging to run both ablation configs in parallel — will use a one-hour GPU slot. tagging @deploy-bot to reserve.

deploy-bot: reserving slot: staging-gpu-2 for 60 minutes starting in 5m. job id: dj-19725.

maya: Thanks — I'll queue both eval configs and attach logs. If we confirm it's tokenization, I can patch prompt-set A to normalize spaces in the broken examples (quick fix) and then run the rerank eval again.

eva: Also FYI — noticed a minor telemetry gap: some eval runs for tinyQ-v2 didn't surface model tags in traces. Filed ticket INF-588. If the gap overlaps our runs, comparisons could be noisy.

sam: Good catch. @maya @hiro let's mark the eval runs with explicit metadata `--tag tinyQ-v3-ablation-19725` so we can filter cleanly.

maya: Will do. Also pinging @sam for CR review: I left comments on #342 re: kv-cache lock ordering — would appreciate a quick pass.

sam: On it, will prioritize after the ablation runs start.

hiro: Blocking note for the team: if the ablation shows quantization is fine, we should schedule a canary rollout to dedicated for 2 hours with traffic split 5%. Otherwise hold rollout.

maya: Agreed. I'll pause the canary until we have ablation results.

qa-bot: regression-harness detected 18 failing examples (prompt-set A_v1) — details: /evals/logs/1972556789/summary.json

maya: thanks all — I'll update later with logs and a short summary. :thumbsup:
